Hi team,

We have a Backend SWE candidate, Aisha Malik, scheduled for Thursday 10/15 at 11:00am PT. I wanted to loop you in for a "ride-along" interview — Vivek, you'll be shadowing and taking notes; Marissa and Lauren will be interviewers.

Quick background: Aisha is coming from a payments infra role, resume attached. She requested live captions and an extra 10 minutes after the coding portion for a short clarifying conversation (accessibility request).

Asks:
- Can you confirm availability for 10/15 11:00–11:50am PT? (Interview is 40m + 10m buffer)
- Marissa: can you confirm Zoom link and passcode so I can add to the calendar?
- Lauren/Vivek: please review the pre-interview brief (attached) — it has the two prompt seeds and judging rubric.

Attachments: Aisha_Malik_resume.pdf, pre-interview-brief.pdf

I can enable live captioning via Zoom if team confirms. We should add the captioning note to the calendar item and the invite message to the candidate.

Thanks — Priya
